objections.answer: I can't promise zero downtime, and nobody honest can.
objections.ask: What would you need to see in a plan to feel safe?
objections.bridge: We design the migration windows around your clinical systems.
objections.never: zero downtime, or any specific downtime figure
objections.ifRepeated: I hear you — let's write down exactly what you'd need in a cutover plan. That becomes the brief.

objections.answer: That's a real cost — so it goes in the comparison.
objections.ask: What would help most: training time, or someone supporting you during the move?
objections.bridge: We can price both options before you make a decision.
objections.ifRepeated: Understood. Let's put a number on it — training time and support during the move both go in the comparison.

objections.answer: I can't promise that, because I haven't seen your setup yet.
objections.ask: What would you need to see to know if it's worth it?
objections.bridge: That's exactly what the comparison is for.
objections.ifRepeated: I still can't promise that before I've seen your estate. The comparison will show the real numbers — that's the only honest answer.

objections.answer: I'd want an expert to answer that properly, not me.
objections.ask: Who looks after compliance on your side?
objections.bridge: We bring the right person in before anything moves.
objections.never: claim compliance yourself — that requires an expert
objections.ifRepeated: Same answer — I won't claim compliance. Let's get your compliance lead in the conversation.

objections.ask: What would make you confident enough to take the next step?
objections.bridge: That's exactly what the comparison is for.
objections.never: I can prove it will work for you
objections.ifRepeated: I hear you — let's define what evidence would look like. What would you want to see?

objections.answer: I don't know your warranty terms, so I won't guess.
objections.ask: What's the date and what does it cover?
objections.bridge: We can plan the move to land before it, and cost an extension as the fallback.
objections.check: Which would you want to see?
objections.never: Nutanix covers the warranty or you won't have a gap
objections.ifRepeated: I still can't guess your terms. Let's map the date and what coverage you need — then plan the options.

objections.answer: I can't name one on this call, and I won't guess.
objections.ask: What would you want to ask them?
objections.bridge: I'll find out which customers we can introduce before the next session.
objections.never: name a specific customer without checking first
objections.ifRepeated: I understand you want to hear from a peer. What's the one question you'd ask them?

objections.answer: Fair, and that's why your [her date] matters.
objections.ask: What would have to be true by then for this to be worth an hour?
objections.bridge: We don't need the full picture now — just enough to see if the next step makes sense.
objections.never: push or guilt-trip her over timing
objections.ifRepeated: I hear you. If [her date] changes, come back to me — I'll keep the comparison ready.

objections.ask: So I send the right thing, what do you want it to answer?
objections.bridge: Then twenty minutes after you've read it: does [day] work?
objections.never: send generic material without asking what she needs it to answer
objections.ifRepeated: Totally fine. One question first: what do you want it to answer? That shapes what I send.

objections.answer: It has, and I'm not here to run it down.
objections.ask: If the quote stands, what's your plan B?
objections.bridge: Would a costed comparison next to the renewal help?
objections.never: run down VMware — she chose it and it's worked
objections.ifRepeated: I'm not asking you to leave VMware. I'm asking what your plan is if the quote stands.

objections.ask: What would they need to see?
objections.bridge: Can they join the working session?
objections.never: try to go around the decision maker
objections.ifRepeated: I hear you — what would you need to bring to them to make it easy?

objections.answer: Understood. I don't know your terms.
objections.ask: Is that a firm end date?
objections.bridge: What would you need to see to plan for it?
objections.never: assume the contract is breakable or promise an early exit
objections.ifRepeated: Understood — when it ends, I want to be the first call. What date does the contract run to?

objections.answer: Fair, you should look at them too, and I can't speak for them.
objections.ask: What would you want from any alternative?
objections.bridge: Let's measure us against that list.
objections.never: claim Nutanix is better than alternatives you can't speak for
objections.ifRepeated: I still can't speak for the others. What matters most to you — let's measure each one against that.

objections.answer: That's a real cost, so it goes in the comparison next to the licence.
objections.ask: Which worries you most: team time, downtime, or new hardware?
objections.bridge: We map that before the comparison goes to your manager.
objections.never: give a migration cost figure without seeing the estate
objections.ifRepeated: I hear you — that's why we map it as part of the comparison. Which concerns you most: team time, downtime, or new hardware?
